- **D052 是关键决策**：α=0.50 confirmed seed-dependent boundary (s42=0/8, s43=6/8)，s44 决定最终叙事
- **Review Issues 19/19 resolved**，Round 2 已提交待审批，写作打磨 5 项已完成，Provenance 89%
